item.text: The toolchain is compliant (Go 1.24.6). The current parser already checks whole-document UTF-8 and some string controls, but its line handling uses broad trimming and does not reliably distinguish comments from string content or reject illegal controls in comments. I’m running the authoritative slices now to identify the exact failures before patching.

item.text: The baseline confirms two lexical failures: comments attached directly to table headers are being mistaken for closing brackets, and comments/newlines inside arrays are not lexed as boundaries. The invalid control/encoding filter itself exits cleanly, but the harness’s `-run` selector does not execute invalid cases in this version, so I’ll also add direct in-language negative tests for those rules and run the full suite for the final verdict.
